accent_contract.accent.kept: The answered, kept truth and the one primary action. Blued steel by day, lume by night — one job, two worlds. Nothing else may be this colour.
accent_contract.accent.spent: The spent fact. Copper, matte, adult — never an alarm, never an error, never destructive-delete.
accent_contract.state.wait: Mandatory, frozen, and any wait in progress — the neither-good-nor-bad channel. Grey-green neutral.
accent_contract.destructive: NO fourth accent exists. Destruction is a system alert's job (SwiftUI .destructive role); in our own surfaces destructive is ink text + the trash glyph + confirmation, never a colour.

_meta.legibility_law: Ink and accents sit only on field, dial or well (the three surfaces); nothing textual ever sits on an accent except onAccent, and no accent ever sits on another accent.
_meta.category_vs_state: Day-truths are STATES (mark geometry + colour); themes are FINISHES (surface swap only); accents never encode category.
_meta.themes: A theme swaps color.surface.* only (five finishes: silver, cream, salmon, slate, moss). color.ink.*, color.accent.*, color.state.* never move.

contrastPairs.note: instrument value, NOT reading text: minor ticks and engraved numerals only. The round declares them droppable — 'below 160pt (widgets) minors drop first, then numerals; bezel, index, hand, arc and count never drop' (VISUAL-LANGUAGE 'Failure mode') — so the reading never depends on them and the 3:1 graphic floor does not apply. Declared at the hairline visibility floor instead. Every SENTENCE that had drifted onto this value now uses ink.secondary, which is AA on all three surfaces.

type.family: SF Pro (system). Display for counts and dial numerals, Text for everything else. No mono, no serif — roles never swap (M-16).

cellNumeral.note: unambiguous at cell size to XXXL; cell grows, numeral floor 12

radius.doctrine: Circles are for time, capsules for actions, 12 for sheets, 6 for day cells, 0 for ruled lists. Never one radius everywhere.

shadow.doctrine: None. Depth is the bezel line (1pt hairline ring) plus one value step (dial above field, well below field). The paywall door dims the room behind it with surface.scrim — a value, not a blur. No drop shadows, no glassmorphism, anywhere.

functional.use: state swaps, sheet presents, tab changes

beat.name: the hand seats
beat.description: the day hand rotates to the index and seats with a single overshoot; the arc closes its final gap
beat.reduceMotion: crossfade open-to-seated, 200ms, remainder text updates instantly
